resources.string: Some videos cannot play directly on this receiver. Choose Switch to screen mirroring at the left of the bottom control bar, then reopen the video on your device.
Play videos on your device and mirror their picture and sound to this receiver.

Select this receiver in the video’s AirPlay menu. Supported videos play on this device and can be controlled from your sending device. An existing screen mirroring stream may not switch automatically.
The receiver stays running. This switch is one-way for the current stream: reopen the video on your device to watch it there, and reconnect screen mirroring if no picture appears.
Screen mirroring selected. Exit the AirPlay video screen on your device and reopen the video. If no picture appears, reconnect screen mirroring.
